units.source_text: 正在此时，太政大臣逝世了。

en.t: Just at this time, the Grand Minister passed away.

units.source_text: 这老大臣是天下之柱石，一旦殂落，皇上亦不胜悲叹。

en.t: This old minister had been a pillar of the realm, and when he died, even the Emperor was overcome with grief.

units.source_text: 昔年暂时隐退，笼闭邸内，尚且引起朝中骚扰；

en.t: In earlier years, even his temporary withdrawal and seclusion within his residence had caused turmoil at court;

units.source_text: 何况今日与世长遗，悲伤之人自然甚多。

en.t: now that he had left the world forever, naturally there were many who mourned him.

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣亦非常惋惜。

en.t: Genji, the Minister of the Interior, also grieved deeply over the loss.

units.source_text: 以前一切政务均可依赖太政大臣主裁，内大臣甚是安闲。

en.t: Before this, all affairs of government could be entrusted to the Grand Minister's judgment, so the Minister of the Interior had been quite at ease.

units.source_text: 今后势必独任其艰，因此更增愁叹。

en.t: From now on, he would inevitably have to bear those burdens alone, and this only deepened his sorrow.

units.source_text: 冷泉帝年仅十四，然而稳重老成，似乎远在这年龄之上，

en.t: Emperor Reizei was only fourteen, yet he was calm and mature, seeming far older than his years,

units.source_text: 躬亲政务，圣明善断，源氏内大臣颇可放心。

en.t: and because he personally attended to government affairs with wise and sound judgment, Genji, the Minister of the Interior, could feel fairly reassured.

units.source_text: 然而太政大臣逝世之后，除了他自己以外，别无可托之后援人。

en.t: Yet after the Grand Minister's death, there was no one besides Genji himself who could be relied on as a source of support.

units.source_text: 谁能代他负此重任，而让他成遂出家修行之夙愿呢？

en.t: Who could take this heavy responsibility in his place and allow him to fulfill his long-held wish to renounce the world and practice the Buddhist path?

units.source_text: 想到这里，便觉太政大臣之早逝甚可痛心。

en.t: When he thought of this, the Grand Minister's early death seemed all the more heartbreaking.

units.source_text: 因此大办追荐佛事，比太政大臣的子孙们办得更加隆重。

en.t: For that reason, he held grand Buddhist memorial services for him, even more splendid than those arranged by the Grand Minister's own descendants.
He also offered sincere condolences and cared for the family in many ways.
